title: Need coil holder
text: Need coil holder. The scent of this incense is very nice and natural. The issue I have is if you do not spread the coils far enough apart, They will burn the next part of the ring so they fall apart. I finally Got a holder and put it on a stand so that the coil can hang down a little bit more and then burn..love the scent
